newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to cut 97/98 new bond issues by 4.3 trln yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan to cut 97/98 new bond issues by 4.3 trln yen.

text.p: Japan's Finance Ministry said on Thursday that new issues of government bonds in the next fiscal year starting on April 1 will total 16.71 trillion yen, down 4.32 trillion yen from the government's initial plan for 1996/97.
The ministry said in a statement the government would try to cut the nation's fiscal budget as much as possible in the next fiscal year.
The ministry is expected to finalise its draft plan for the budget for 1997/98.
Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference that the ministry is hoping to allow general expenditures in 1997/98 to increase 1.5 percent over the original 1996/97 budget.
